text: Which system integration specialists in Brisbane are best for connecting ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP, and Microsoft 365 systems?

result.keyword: Which system integration specialists in Brisbane are best for connecting ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP, and Microsoft 365 systems?
result.markdown:
For Brisbane businesses connecting ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP and Microsoft 365, I’d shortlist specialists based on two things: **proven experience with your core business platforms and the ability to integrate systems reliably**, rather than general IT support alone.

There probably isn’t one provider that is equally strong across all five areas. The best fit may be a specialist ERP partner for MYOB Acumatica, an enterprise integration consultancy for SAP and CRM, or a lead integrator that coordinates the whole project.

## Best Brisbane specialists to shortlist

(Best starting point for MYOB Acumatica)

Tonic combines MYOB Acumatica implementation and support with ReadySoft, its software development arm, which builds custom ERP add-ons and integrations. That makes it a strong first conversation if Acumatica is your operational or financial system of record. A Brisbane-based SAP-focused consultancy whose capabilities include SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), S/4HANA and integration modernisation. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJb5A6o7dZkWsRpOOQoNRjoXQ&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** SAP-heavy environments where SAP integration architecture and extensions are central to the project.

**Confirm\:** Experience connecting SAP with MYOB Acumatica and your CRM, plus responsibility for end-to-end delivery.

These providers may be useful if Microsoft 365 or broader application integration is a major part of your requirements.

[www.outsourceadvantage.com.au](https://www.outsourceadvantage.com.au/services/systems-integration/brisbane?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | [Systems integration](https://www.outsourceadvantage.com.au/services/systems-integration/brisbane) |


These are candidates to assess, not a verified ranking of the best firms. Publicly available information does not establish that any one provider has demonstrated delivery experience across every system in your list.

## How I would choose

**If MYOB Acumatica is your main ERP**

Start with Tonic Technologies and Stratus Consulting Group. Ask for examples of production integrations with your CRM and SAP environment.

---

**If several platforms must exchange data reliably**

Start with Intelligent Pathways. Ask for an integration design covering APIs, middleware, data ownership, error handling and monitoring.

---

**If SAP is the most complex system**

Include DalRae Solutions in the shortlist and ask who will take responsibility for the non-SAP connectors and end-to-end testing.

## Questions to ask before engaging anyone

1. Have you delivered a live integration involving **MYOB Acumatica, SAP and a CRM**? Can we speak to a reference client?
2. How would you connect Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint or Power Platform where relevant?
3. Would you use native connectors, APIs, an integration platform such as MuleSoft, or custom middleware? Why?
4. How will you handle duplicate records, failed synchronisations, conflicting updates and audit trails?
5. Who owns the complete solution after go-live, and what are the support SLA and ongoing integration costs?

## One detail would help me narrow this down

Which CRM are you using, and which SAP product do you have? For example, Salesforce or Dynamics 365, and SAP Business One or SAP S/4HANA.

That will make a significant difference to which Brisbane specialist is the strongest fit for your actual integration project.
